episodes.title: Sam Riley's Body
episodes.summary: When a farmer's strike led by a local preacher escalates, a man from his past is sent to restore order.

episodes.title: Which Side Are You On
episodes.summary: As Seth and the farmers ward off the treacherous Black Legion vigilante group, Creeley works to learn more about his brother's new life and the woman he shares it with.

episodes.title: One Penny
episodes.summary: When the local farms face foreclosure, Seth and Amelia must find a way to win them back. Creeley and Bessie run afoul of the Black Legion.

episodes.title: The Emperor of Ice Cream
episodes.summary: Negotiations commence between the farmers and the bank. But things turn bloody when Creeley divides the farmers.

episodes.title: Den of Lost Souls
episodes.summary: When a traveling carnival comes to Holden, a collection of new faces put Seth and Creeley on their toes, but it's a friend from the past that truly shakes things up.

episodes.title: In Wyoming Fashion
episodes.summary: Seth and Lew are presented with an unexpected opportunity when banker Calvin Rumple is run out of town.

episodes.title: A Different Species
episodes.summary: Creeley meets his master on an exclusive hunting retreat, but finds there is more than one game at play; Seth infiltrates a nearby factory.

episodes.title: The Goodness of Men
episodes.summary: When Bessie discovers the grand industrial plans for Holden, Seth and Amelia must decide whether to protect her from the Black Legion.

episodes.title: Dark Was the Night, Cold Was the Ground
episodes.summary: Seth and the farmers take on the Black Legion with help from unlikely allies.

episodes.title: God's Body
episodes.summary: Seth and Creeley must confront the truth about their past and figure out a way to survive the rapidly arriving future.
